Starting prices cover the listed scope. We confirm requirements, availability and the final quote before work begins. Delivery estimates start after agreed content, access and deposit are received. Revisions apply to the agreed direction. Any applicable taxes are confirmed in your quote.

Before we start

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Answers before we get started.

Can you look after a site built by someone else?

We can review it before taking on the work. We need suitable access and information about the platform, hosting and services it relies on.

Are new features part of website care?

Your care plan defines what is included. Larger features and extra requests receive a separate fixed quote before work begins.

What happens if an urgent issue comes up?

Your proposal sets out how to report problems and the support arrangements available. We confirm response expectations before support begins.
